flora: Unfurling fiddlehead (thick, tightly wound green spiral covered in fine, velvety bronze fuzz)
Fern pinna close-up (a segment of the frond showcasing perfectly repeating rounded leaflets)
Spore clusters / sori (pattern of neat, raised circular dots on the golden-brown underside of a leaf)
Rhizome segment (fuzzy, thick underground stem with stumpy rootlets branching off)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; structural repetition; avoid thin, wispy stems; the fiddlehead must feel plump, juicy, and deliberately stylized; clear contrast between the fuzzy bronze base and waxy green leaves.

visual_logic.composition: Tiled layout: Top-Left: a hero macro shot of a plump, spiraling fiddlehead; Top-Right: a detailed grid-like view of a single frond leaflet arrangement; Bottom-Left: the underside of a leaf showing the geometric pattern of brown spore circles; Bottom-Right: a short, thick segment of the fuzzy root rhizome.
visual_logic.ground: A crisp, flat backdrop of dark river moss, framing the emerald green structures.
visual_logic.lighting: Bright, omnidirectional light to separate the bronze velvety texture from the smooth, waxy leaf surfaces.
